name: How much does door casing installation usually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does door casing installation usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the trim style, material, labor, and whether old casing has to be removed or damage repaired. Basic jobs are usually less expensive than custom profiles, paint-grade finish work, or projects that also need jamb or drywall fixes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price varies by trim type, labor, and repair needs. Simple casing jobs cost less than custom trim or projects that require removing old casing and fixing the wall or jamb.
